AboutPage.title: About Me
AboutPage.subtitle: Bringing smiles and colour to children's faces
AboutPage.introduction: Hi and welcome to Face Art Obwalden! I love painting kids' favourite characters and creating small moments of magic.

story.title: My Story
story.content: What started as a simple hobby grew into something I truly enjoy. Seeing children light up when they recognise themselves in the mirror is my favourite part of this work.

experience.title: Experience & Approach
experience.content: I’m based in Obwalden and paint at birthdays, family celebrations, and all kinds of events. I use high-quality, water-based, skin-safe paints that wash off easily. Whether it’s quick designs for many children or detailed artwork for a special moment, I always take my time and paint with care.

commitment.title: My Commitment
commitment.content: Every child should feel comfortable and happy while being painted. I keep my setup clean, my paints safe, and the experience calm and enjoyable.

questions.question: What kind of paints do you use?
questions.answer: I use high-quality, water-based face paints made for skin. They are non-toxic, hypoallergenic, and wash off easily with soap and water.

questions.question: How long does each face painting take?
questions.answer: Simple designs take around 3–5 minutes. More detailed ones take 8–15 minutes. For parties, planning 7–10 minutes per child works well.

questions.question: What age groups do you paint for?
questions.answer: I paint children from about 3 years old. For younger ones, small hand or arm designs are usually easier.

questions.question: How far in advance should I book?
questions.answer: 2–3 weeks ahead is ideal, especially for weekends, but I try to help with last-minute requests whenever possible.

questions.question: What do you need from me as the host?
questions.answer: Just a small space for my table and chair. I bring all materials. For outdoor events, a shaded or covered area is best.

questions.question: Do you have insurance?
questions.answer: Yes, I’m fully insured for all my face painting activities.

questions.question: What happens if it rains at an outdoor event?
questions.answer: I need a covered space. If the event is cancelled due to weather, we can easily find a new date.

questions.question: Can you create custom designs or themes?
questions.answer: Yes! I’m happy to match your party theme or create designs based on your child’s favourite ideas.

questions.question: How do I care for the face painting after the event?
questions.answer: The paint lasts around 4–6 hours depending on activity. To remove it, use warm water and mild soap. No strong rubbing needed.

questions.question: What are your prices?
questions.answer: Prices depend on the event, duration, and number of children. Please contact me for a simple and clear quote.

contact.title: More questions?
contact.description: Feel free to reach out. I’m happy to help you plan your event.

TermsConditionsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
TermsConditionsPage.subtitle: General Terms and Conditions (T&C) - Face Art Obwalden

contract.title: 1. Contract
contract.content: These T&C form part of all contracts between Face Art Obwalden and the client. Changes or additional agreements must be documented in writing.

offer.title: 2. Offer
offer.content: All offers from Face Art Obwalden are non-binding. A contract is only concluded once written confirmation of the order has been received. By accepting an offer or booking a service, the client accepts these T&C. If changes become necessary after the contract is concluded that are important for the completion of the event, the client will be informed as quickly as possible.

breaks.title: 3. Break Regulations
breaks.content: For assignments up to 4 hours, the artist is entitled to a 30-minute break. For assignments of 6 hours or more, the artist is entitled to two 30-minute breaks. Breaks are coordinated together with the client. During working hours, the artist may drink, eat, and use the toilet.

cancellation.title: 4. Cancellation by Client
cancellation.content: In case of cancellation by the client, the following costs apply:
items: Up to 30 days before the date: 25% of the service fee
29 to 10 days before the date: 50% of the service fee
From 9 days before the date: 75% of the service fee
cancellation.additionalNote: Costs already incurred will be charged in addition.

extraordinaryCancellation.title: 5. Extraordinary Cancellation
extraordinaryCancellation.content: If an event cannot take place due to bad weather or official orders, both parties may withdraw from the contract. If the order is cancelled for other reasons, the cancellation fee according to section 4 applies.

cancellationByArtist.title: 6. Cancellation by Face Art Obwalden
cancellationByArtist.content: If Face Art Obwalden cannot attend a scheduled event due to illness, accident, or family reasons, a suitable substitute will be sought where possible. However, a substitute cannot be guaranteed. There is no claim for compensation or damages.

supervision.title: 7. Face Painting is Not Childcare
supervision.content: Face Art Obwalden provides face painting and/or glitter tattoos. Supervision of children remains at all times with parents, guardians, or responsible caregivers. Face Art Obwalden does not provide childcare services. No liability is assumed for soiled clothing or personal belongings.

prices.title: 8. Prices and Costs
prices.content: Prices depend on location, date, duration, and type of assignment. All prices are in Swiss Francs and include material costs. If no free parking is available, parking fees will be charged to the client. Typographical errors and omissions are reserved.

payment.title: 9. Payment Terms
payment.content: The invoice is due within 10 days of the event. Payment can be made by:
payment.additionalNote: Only Swiss Francs are accepted. Additional working time or spontaneous extensions not previously agreed will be charged at an additional fee per half hour started.

paints.title: 10. Face Paints and Glitter
paints.content: Face Art Obwalden uses professional, high-quality face paints and cosmetic glitter. The products used comply with applicable safety regulations and are skin-friendly. All paints can be removed with water and mild soap. Despite careful product selection, Face Art Obwalden assumes no liability for allergic reactions or skin irritations.

photos.title: 11. Photos and Image Material
photos.content: Photos of painted children may only be taken and published with the consent of parents or guardians. Consent must be provided in writing. If photos or videos are used for advertising, social media, or the website, Face Art Obwalden must be mentioned as the service provider.

advertising.title: 12. Advertising
advertising.content: Face Art Obwalden may draw attention to its own services during the event, for example with company clothing, business cards, flyers, or a banner.

workspace.title: 13. Workspace
workspace.content: The client must provide a suitable workspace. For outdoor events, this must be protected from sun, wind, and rain. Required space:
spacings: For one person at least 2 x 3 meters
For two people at least 4.5 x 3 meters
workspace.tentNote: If no suitable weather protection is available, Face Art Obwalden can provide its own tent measuring 4.5 x 3 meters for CHF 50.00 per day.

liability.title: 14. Liability
liability.content: Face Art Obwalden is only liable for damages caused intentionally or through gross negligence. Liability for indirect damages or consequential damages is excluded to the extent permitted by law.

privacy.title: 15. Data Protection
privacy.content: Personal data is only used for processing inquiries, offers, and orders. Data is treated confidentially and is not passed on to third parties without consent, except where required by law.
